'''Luis Rodriguez''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2000 Cedar Grove tournament]] on 11 March 2000 with Tatooine Mains, according to Michael Dalton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d340">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-12-3-11-00-cedar-grove-njd340/ 3-11-00-cedar-grove-nj], DeckTech (Michael "faramir" Dalton, 12 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-12-3-11-00-cedar-grove-njd340/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
